name: Rations
description: Three days of dense, joyless food.

name: Canned Food
description: Two cans with the labels gone. They keep forever.

name: Dried Food
description: Dried meat and fruit in a cloth bag. Light, salty, and lasting.

name: Water
description: A full water container. Three days for one careful person.

name: Smoked Meat
description: Meat smoked over a low fire. It lasts if the smokehouse holds.

name: Meat
description: Fresh meat, wrapped in cloth. It will not keep.

name: Seeds
description: A packet of vegetable seeds for a garden that might survive the winter.

name: Fertilizer
description: A sack of fertilizer. It grows food, and it can be made into worse things.

name: Salt
description: A cloth bag of coarse salt. It preserves food and marks thresholds.

name: Candles
description: A bundle of candles. Light, warmth, and a quiet ritual.
